support_claim: Unresolved-preservation evidence blocks closure because legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and an alternate Wyoming LLC candidate remains live.

propositions.proposition: Billing and the MSA use the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. as the name used on billing and in the MSA.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics".
propositions.relevance: Documents an alternate informal name for the counterparty, indicating naming variation but not identity with registry:3840192.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces a separate registry entity as a live candidate for the contracting party, preventing closure of identity between the billing referent and registry:3840192.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly states that identity between the billing referent and a registry entity cannot be established.

propositions.proposition: The registry link should be treated as unresolved.

propositions.proposition: Registry ID 3840192 corresponds to "NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS INC" incorporated in Delaware with active status.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent registry:3840192 to a named Delaware corporation; name similarity to the billing name is present but does not by itself establish identity.

propositions.relevance: Corroborates the billing-side referent name associated with billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.
